name: Color Names
content:
**Description**: This dataset is a collection of unique, creative color names paired with their specific digital color codes.

[Source](https://github.com/meodai/color-names)

**License Type**: MIT License

**_Columns_**:

* **name**: This column provides the creative title or human-readable identifier assigned to a specific color.
* **hex**: This column contains the six-character hexadecimal code used to precisely represent that exact color in digital design and web formatting.
